raw: [name="Oracle"]We've traveled far enough, and I fear there's no longer a point in continuing our exploration.
speaker: Oracle
content: We've traveled far enough, and I fear there's no longer a point in continuing our exploration.

raw: [name="Oracle"]Ten thousand day cycles have passed since I entered hibernation, but Terra's changes have been limited.
speaker: Oracle
content: Ten thousand day cycles have passed since I entered hibernation, but Terra's changes have been limited.

raw: [name="Oracle"]The spark of life from Talos-II is still weak. The other seeds of hope planted by my former companions have shown no signs of sprouting either.
speaker: Oracle
content: The spark of life from Talos-II is still weak. The other seeds of hope planted by my former companions have shown no signs of sprouting either.

speaker: AMa-10
content: (Expressing dismay)

raw: [name="Oracle"]Are you disappointed? No... I have expected this result long ago, actually.
speaker: Oracle
content: Are you disappointed? No... I have expected this result long ago, actually.

speaker: Oracle
content: I miscalculated the pace at which everything would develop. It's not the right time, and there's only so much I can do.

speaker: Oracle
content: Time... I just need more time.

raw: [name="Oracle"]I can't continue wasting the life of this body. I have to return to sleep inside the sarcophagus, and wait for an opportunity more ripe than this.
speaker: Oracle
content: I can't continue wasting the life of this body. I have to return to sleep inside the sarcophagus, and wait for an opportunity more ripe than this.

raw: [name="Oracle"]...I have to admit, I broke my promise, and this is a sort of betrayal.
speaker: Oracle
content: ...I have to admit, I broke my promise, and this is a sort of betrayal.

raw: [name="Oracle"]But it is because I still love life that I must have hope. There is no other way.
speaker: Oracle
content: But it is because I still love life that I must have hope. There is no other way.

raw: [name="Oracle"]Though I fear she's already anticipated my early awakening.
speaker: Oracle
content: Though I fear she's already anticipated my early awakening.

raw: [name="Oracle"]Inside that sarcophagus, I discovered a lynchpin-modifying program.
speaker: Oracle
content: Inside that sarcophagus, I discovered a lynchpin-modifying program.

speaker: AMa-10
content: (Expressing confusion)

raw: [name="Oracle"]Technology born in a lost age, used to strengthen our thoughts and conviction. Without it, many would lose the will needed to make it through that period of endless despair.
speaker: Oracle
content: Technology born in a lost age, used to strengthen our thoughts and conviction. Without it, many would lose the will needed to make it through that period of endless despair.

raw: [name="Oracle"]She and I, we went through it together...
speaker: Oracle
content: She and I, we went through it together...

raw: [name="Oracle"]She knows and understands me best, of course, but it is also why our differing opinions are my deepest regret.
speaker: Oracle
content: She knows and understands me best, of course, but it is also why our differing opinions are my deepest regret.

raw: [name="Oracle"]She anticipated my actions, and the hidden program within the sarcophagus activated when I woke up. It can modify my cognition, and the purpose of our 'debates'...
speaker: Oracle
content: She anticipated my actions, and the hidden program within the sarcophagus activated when I woke up. It can modify my cognition, and the purpose of our 'debates'...

raw: [name="Oracle"]And I must return to that same sole sarcophagus to extend my life, even if that means...
speaker: Oracle
content: And I must return to that same sole sarcophagus to extend my life, even if that means...

speaker: Oracle
content: I don't have much time left.

raw: [name="Oracle"]No, I shouldn't call you by that anymore.
speaker: Oracle
content: No, I shouldn't call you by that anymore.

raw: [name="Oracle"]It's a code name, an identifier for a mechanical creation. I should give you a true name.
speaker: Oracle
content: It's a code name, an identifier for a mechanical creation. I should give you a true name.

raw: [name="Oracle"]Calcite... birefringent crystals capable of refracting a single light source into two polarized lights. A beautiful phenomenon, like you.
speaker: Oracle
content: Calcite... birefringent crystals capable of refracting a single light source into two polarized lights. A beautiful phenomenon, like you.

raw: [name="Oracle"]Calcite... Kal'tsit... that'll do. Do you like this name?
speaker: Oracle
content: Calcite... Kal'tsit... that'll do. Do you like this name?

speaker: AMa-10
content: (Expressing joy)

raw: [name="Oracle"]There are some things I won't have time to do. I hope you can finish them for me.
speaker: Oracle
content: There are some things I won't have time to do. I hope you can finish them for me.

raw: [name="Oracle"]Kal'tsit, I hope you can protect the life on this great land.
speaker: Oracle
content: Kal'tsit, I hope you can protect the life on this great land.

raw: [name="Oracle"]New civilizations are always fragile, but harsh environments will show no mercy.
speaker: Oracle
content: New civilizations are always fragile, but harsh environments will show no mercy.

raw: [name="Oracle"]It is arrogant to interfere with a civilization's development, but we don't have many chances left. This may be our last opportunity.
speaker: Oracle
content: It is arrogant to interfere with a civilization's development, but we don't have many chances left. This may be our last opportunity.

raw: [name="Oracle"]Civilizations tend to repeat the same mistakes—sinking into violence, unverifiable thought pitfalls, and dead ends of self doubt...
speaker: Oracle
content: Civilizations tend to repeat the same mistakes—sinking into violence, unverifiable thought pitfalls, and dead ends of self doubt...

raw: [name="Oracle"]There's no escaping all of that, but just a tiny deviation is enough to wreck a whole civilization. The existence of civilization itself is already a sort of miracle...
speaker: Oracle
content: There's no escaping all of that, but just a tiny deviation is enough to wreck a whole civilization. The existence of civilization itself is already a sort of miracle...

raw: [name="Oracle"]So, Kal'tsit, I hope you will guide them.
speaker: Oracle
content: So, Kal'tsit, I hope you will guide them.

raw: [name="Oracle"]Your gemini cycle grants you a practically infinite life. You can follow immature civilizations as they develop, and guide them onto a path forward with your knowledge.
speaker: Oracle
content: Your gemini cycle grants you a practically infinite life. You can follow immature civilizations as they develop, and guide them onto a path forward with your knowledge.

raw: [name="Oracle"]It's an arduous mission, but you might manage it, you should—
speaker: Oracle
content: It's an arduous mission, but you might manage it, you should—
A moment of silence.

raw: The passionate speech comes to a halt. Oracle looks at the slender, delicate mechanical life, then gazes at the distant mountains half buried by sandstorms.
content: The passionate speech comes to a halt. Oracle looks at the slender, delicate mechanical life, then gazes at the distant mountains half buried by sandstorms.

speaker: Oracle
content: No...

raw: [name="Oracle"]...Forget what I just said, Kal'tsit. All of it.
speaker: Oracle
content: ...Forget what I just said, Kal'tsit. All of it.

raw: [name="Oracle"]Go, Kal'tsit. Go look around you, then see what lies by the most distant of mountains. Go seek what forms existence takes.
speaker: Oracle
content: Go, Kal'tsit. Go look around you, then see what lies by the most distant of mountains. Go seek what forms existence takes.

raw: [name="Oracle"]...I must go back. Wake me up when you need to.
speaker: Oracle
content: ...I must go back. Wake me up when you need to.

raw: [name="Oracle"]Kal'tsit, I hope you'll... Or maybe I should say, the only mission I assign you now, is this:
speaker: Oracle
content: Kal'tsit, I hope you'll... Or maybe I should say, the only mission I assign you now, is this:

speaker: Oracle
content: Find yourself.

raw: [name="Oracle"]Search for traces of life. Search for hope and a future.
speaker: Oracle
content: Search for traces of life. Search for hope and a future.

speaker: Oracle
content: Kal'tsit... Go find your own answer.

content: You really have surprised me, AMa-10.

content: However, do you really intend to kill me via this method?

content: I knew from a long time ago your consciousness was already assimilated into the information within Originium.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Under these circumstances, it is impossible to truly kill you.

content: Under these circumstances, it is impossible to truly kill you.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: But what Theresa and Theresis accomplished convinced me of something.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Your control over Originium is not absolute, and there still exist some methods to limit your authority over it.

speaker: Priestess
content: I did meet the two you speak of, within the Originium.

raw: [name="Priestess"]Their efforts were indeed unexpected, and a pleasantly surprising struggle.
speaker: Priestess
content: Their efforts were indeed unexpected, and a pleasantly surprising struggle.

raw: [name="Priestess"]But what of it? How are you so sure now that killing me here won't be a futile act?
speaker: Priestess
content: But what of it? How are you so sure now that killing me here won't be a futile act?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]When Mon3tr attacked you, you chose to defend yourself.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: When Mon3tr attacked you, you chose to defend yourself.

speaker: Priestess
content: How did you do it?

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: I see you have noticed.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Based on Theresa's research into Originium as well as the trap you set for Dr. {@nickname}, I added a few plans to your awakening room.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Based on Theresa's research into Originium as well as the trap you set for Dr. {@nickname}, I added a few plans to your awakening room.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]As long as you wake up here, your consciousness will be trapped in this body, unable to return to Originium's sea of information.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: As long as you wake up here, your consciousness will be trapped in this body, unable to return to Originium's sea of information.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Perhaps you will eventually manage to break through this restriction, and regain control over Originium, but right now you are merely human.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Perhaps you will eventually manage to break through this restriction, and regain control over Originium, but right now you are merely human.

raw: [name="Priestess"]To think you'd go this far to rebel against me—
speaker: Priestess
content: To think you'd go this far to rebel against me—

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Priestess, you are not Terra's creator. The life on this land has no obligation to bend to your will.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Priestess, you are not Terra's creator. The life on this land has no obligation to bend to your will.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]...This is my revenge on you, and my final act of resistance.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: ...This is my revenge on you, and my final act of resistance.

content: Maybe...

Are we quite finished playing yet?

speaker: Amiya
content: How—

content: As you say, there is indeed a chance for you to kill me now...

raw: [name="Priestess"]But how does a single substitute made of Originium fluster you so?

content: But how does a single substitute made of Originium fluster you so?

raw: [name="Priestess"]AMa-10, I have no intention of debating the value of your beliefs.

content: AMa-10, I have no intention of debating the value of your beliefs.

raw: [name="Priestess"]The principles you have always insisted on are so insignificant I can't even find a credible logical framework to assess their significance.
speaker: Priestess
content: The principles you have always insisted on are so insignificant I can't even find a credible logical framework to assess their significance.

raw: [name="Priestess"]It is not uncommon for experiments to turn out like this—small errors ultimately growing into huge obstacles. I have no choice but to accept this result.

raw: [name="Priestess"]I'm very sorry, but I must treat you as an error, and wipe you out.

content: What a pity.

content: Don't spare too much worry for me. Rhodes Island shouldn't be so fragile that one person's departure would leave it unable to proceed on.
My hope?

raw: It is to protect yours and Amiya's hopes.
content: It is to protect yours and Amiya's hopes.

raw: Though our definitions of 'protect' have nothing in common, it's an oath I will never abandon. I will be standing here with you, until the very end.
content: Though our definitions of 'protect' have nothing in common, it's an oath I will never abandon. I will be standing here with you, until the very end.

raw: I have found the meaning of my life.
content: I have found the meaning of my life.
Please lead Rhodes Island...

{@nickname}.
